title: PRESIDENTIAL ELECTIONS
desc: The first President of Europa RP is being elected! From applications to the popular vote, here is everything you need to know about the 3 stages.
body: >Since the fresh start of Europa Roleplay, we are thrilled to announce that the Presidential Administration is returning! We are looking for our first President through a democratic 3-stage process.<div class=
>Starts May 13, 12:00. Requirements: Lvl 10+, RP Nickname, Clean Record. Cost: 100 Gold.<div class=
>Candidates advertise via San Andreas News Agency and RP events to win over the public.<div class=
>May 15, 16:00. Level 2+ players vote at City Hall. Winner declared at 19:00.
>Ready to lead? Submit your request via Discord today!

title: MAJOR UPDATE v2.1.5
desc: New interiors for Mafias, Civilian jobs (Miner, Sawmill, Construction), Criminal car theft quests, and Neon tuning options are now live!
body: >The v2.1.5 Major Update is officially live, bringing a massive wave of content and quality-of-life improvements.<div class=

>New Interiors: Yakuza, LCN, Russian Mafia, and JihadiCivilian Jobs: Factory, Miner, Sawmill, and Construction SiteCriminal Quests: Car theft, vehicle parts/drug delivery for gangsTuning: Added Neon options and the new /tazer gun<h4 class=

>Fixed recurring Godmode bug after deathResolved SWAT Helicopter coordinates bugOptimized server performance and fixed Fuel/Payday bag bugsRemoved unoptimized Ghetto Gym and useless mapping under LS bridge

title: A New Chapter
desc: As the year comes to an end, the world slows down under the quiet glow of winter lights. A moment when the old naturally gives way to the new.
body: >Europa Roleplay is a space where stories weave into a single pattern, where attention brings reality to life, and a chosen role begins to respond in return.
>The New Year is not just a change of numbers — it is a gentle reboot. We enter it with renewed energy ⚡, a more refined atmosphere 🌫️, and even deeper interaction 🎭.<div class=
>Reality is written by those who play.

title: GLOBAL PHOTO CONTEST
desc: Show where you’re from! Contest runs until Nov 26. Win epic prizes by showing your country, style, and creativity.
body: >🎉 GLOBAL PHOTO CONTEST BY EUROPA ROLE PLAY 🌍
